summary: Kohl's Corporation filed an 8-K on August 26, 2026, covering Items 2.02, 7.01, 8.01, and 9.01. The filing reports Q2 FY2026 earnings and raised FY2026 guidance via press release (Exhibit 99.1) and presentation materials (Exhibit 99.2). Item 8.01 notes a previously declared quarterly cash dividend of $0.125 per share, payable September 23, 2026, to shareholders of record September 9, 2026. This is a routine earnings and dividend announcement, not a special situation. No M&A, activist, or restructuring activity is mentioned. What to watch: ongoing operational performance and capital allocation; no risk-arb angle.
